A.notes: A has a clear editorial idea—on-call triage reduced to the single anomalous line—and it carries from the hero through the step copy, product demo, and install section. The typography is the strongest asset, and the scroll-strip suggests purposeful story motion: routine lines pass by, then the terminal and result view progressively resolve into the answer. It is also cleanly responsive and passes the measured accessibility checks.

B.notes: B is competent and readable in structure, but the concept lands as a fairly standard SaaS landing page rather than a distinctive point of view for an on-call tool. The scroll-strip shows useful progression in the demo, but the motion appears mostly like conventional reveals/typing rather than a stronger narrative system. It fails the hard gate on contrast with 20 failing nodes, which overrides the otherwise solid craft.

raw.why: A is stronger conceptually and typographically while also clearing all hard gates; B is disqualified by contrast failures and feels more generic.
